title: Quantified Boolean formula machine
statement: The function assigns a seven-register, two-decider instruction to each machine state. It specifies the full control flow for initializing the stack, validating and traversing the quantified formula, evaluating its matrix and literals, returning child values, and carrying out the copy, doubling, move, subtraction, and halving loops; each branch, register update, decider call, and Boolean return is given by the corresponding state case.
hypotheses_covered: machine state is an element of the defined state type
